protocol.repeat_1: single task per call; condition order alternates by fixture
protocol.repeat_2: five-ID batch; reverse fixture order; compact condition uses OZ/5 matrix
protocol.temperature_or_sampling_controls: CLI does not expose a verified sampling setting; defaults kept identical

readiness_check.note: Readiness check is reported separately and excluded from the 20 coding task cells.

evaluator_revisions.rule: Initial scorer did not support ast.keyword/ast.Lambda; first four observed scores are retained per call.

Rescores frozen raw answers; supports explicitly allowed builtin keyword/lambda syntax and safe builtin ValueError raises. Still rejects attributes, imports, disallowed calls, malformed/duplicate/nonfinite JSON, and any changed public function signature.

batch_output_contract_note: Both paired batch prompts request a results array with exact task IDs/order, while the shared COMMON_RULES earlier says to return function_source and explanation in one object. This uncorrected wording conflict is logged; do not treat batch results as a clean estimate of format preference.
limitations: Short pilot over five synthetic functions; findings do not establish general coding ability or production reliability.
CLI telemetry may expose input/output/cached/reasoning usage only partially; tokenizer estimates are reported separately and are not provider billing.
Wall times include local CLI/session startup and are not model-only latency.
The isolated subprocess and AST allowlist reduce execution surface; this is not a security sandbox.
No real project files, production changes, test execution, network, or physical validation were involved.
Timeouts, malformed responses, missing/duplicate IDs, rejected AST and runtime errors remain in the denominator as failures.
Model did not run tools or tests. The local evaluator separately executed accepted candidate functions against fixed hidden test vectors in isolated child processes.

provider_usage_collection_note: Usage totals sum every retained provider usage record per call. Each of the 12 coding calls exposed exactly one record; readiness is separate.
cli_wall_time_note: Per-call wall_seconds includes the local CLI lifecycle; the first four recovered calls have no retained wall_seconds and are omitted from observed-call aggregates.
